findings.reason: the plan should either extend §16 to this caller or state in §16 why it is excluded, because as written its "one mechanism remains" claim is false and a jt-60sa wiki-context lookup stays empty.
findings.text: the wiki-context vector search runs `SEARCH node IN (VECTOR INDEX wiki_chunk_embedding ... LIMIT $k)` and then filters `WHERE p.facility_id = $facility` on the joined WikiPage, so a small facility's chunks are discarded after the global ANN cut — the exact defect §16 exists to remove — yet §16's enumeration of the affected searches omits this site, which is the signal scanner's own wiki-context lookup and is reached for jt-60sa

findings.reason: naming it lets the author move it onto the same in-`SEARCH` `build_vector_search` pre-filter §16 lands elsewhere, or scope it out explicitly; without that, §16's "one mechanism" claim is inaccurate and the jt-60sa code-context path silently ignores facility.
findings.text: the code-context vector search runs `SEARCH node IN (VECTOR INDEX code_chunk_embedding ... LIMIT 3)` and then applies `WHERE src.facility_id = $facility` after the cut, so a small facility's code context is invisible and only the global top-3 chunks are ever considered — and this is the same file §9 and §16 already edit

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — each remaining section deepens an existing module instead of spreading surface: §17 puts both the fetch and the count SQL and the retry predicate in the one label-parameterised `embed_worker`, §16 routes the in-`SEARCH` predicate through the existing `build_vector_search` owner (`imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py`) and the one index annotation, and §9 reduces three DataAccess call sites to one `persist_data_access`.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §16 claims "one facility-filter mechanism remains for every index that carries facility_id" but enumerates only `imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py` and `imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py`; two further consumers of the same two indexes still post-filter facility after the ANN cut, `imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/wiki.py` (wiki_chunk_embedding) and `imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py` (code_chunk_embedding), while the correct in-`SEARCH` mechanism already exists in `imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py`'s `build_vector_search` (used by `imas_codex/ingestion/search.py`).
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §16 and §17 each state "Interface budget: nothing added", §14 reuses `discover paths -r`, and §9 names what it retires (a duplicate remote-environment probe and a duplicate DataAccess `MERGE`) for the single function it adds.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — every remaining section extends machinery it cites by name: §17 names the `imas_codex/discovery/base/embed_worker.py` owner (`_fetch_unembedded` / `_count_unembedded`) and `imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py`'s reset specs, §16 extends §12's `vector_index_filters` annotation and the `GraphClient.ensure_vector_indexes` owner, and §14 reuses the existing `discover paths -r/--root` scoping option rather than adding one.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no section adds a pass-through layer; §9's `persist_data_access` and the `environment=` argument on `get_python_status` each consolidate duplicates and state why the behaviour cannot be folded into the existing mechanism.
